zh-CN.intro: 在技术、生活与自我之间，寻找值得追问的问题。这里收集我的观察、判断，以及不断变化的理解。

zh-CN.about_title: 保持好奇，也保持自己的判断。
zh-CN.about_copy: 我是无来。我喜欢从熟悉的事情里，看见不熟悉的问题：技术怎样改变人，工作怎样进入生活，一个人又怎样与自己相处。这里是我的个人博客，记录真实经历，也留下可继续修正的判断。
zh-CN.about_second: 思考可以借助工具，生活需要亲自经历。愿这些文字成为一扇窗，而不是一个必须接受的答案。

zh-CN.footer: 好奇没有边界，判断仍需落地。
zh-CN.end: 一个问题的结束，也可以是下一次观察的开始。

en.name: Wulai
en.intro: Questions worth asking about technology, everyday life, and ourselves. Observations, judgments, and an understanding that keeps changing.
en.archive: The shapes our thoughts leave behind.
en.archive_note: Technology, work, family, and growth. A chronological collection, with room for thought to wander.

en.about_title: Stay curious. Keep thinking for yourself.
en.about_copy: I’m Wulai. I look for unfamiliar questions inside familiar things: how technology changes us, how work enters our lives, and how we live with ourselves. This personal blog gathers lived experiences and judgments that remain open to revision.
en.about_second: Tools can help us think; life still asks to be experienced. Let these essays be a window, rather than an answer you have to accept.

en.shelf_note: Four classics, with original texts and plain-language notes. A quiet corner for reading.
en.footer: Curiosity travels widely. Judgment stays grounded.
en.end: The end of one question can begin another observation.
